content:
This year, the joint British Mathematics Colloquium / British Applied Mathematics Colloquium features a workshop on "Formal Methods in Mathematical Proof".

There is still space for contributed talks on 25 June.

The early bird deadline for registration closes on 15 March.

https://sites.exeter.ac.uk/bmc-bamc2025/

We are still looking for more contributed talks for the Formal Methods workshop of the British Mathematics Colloquium. Please do register your interest:

https://sites.exeter.ac.uk/bmc-bamc2025/
